claim.claim-text: 1. A nozzle for a liquid-cooled plasma arc torch, the nozzle comprising:
2. The nozzle of claim 1, wherein the body is thermally conductive.
3. The nozzle of claim 1 or claim 2 wherein the inlet means is located between the distal end and the proximal end of the body.
4. The nozzle of any of claims 1 to 3 wherein the outlet means is located between the distal end of the body and the inlet means.
5. The nozzle of any preceding claim, wherein each of the inlet means and outlet means is oriented at a non-zero angle relative to the longitudinal axis.

6. The nozzle of any preceding claim, wherein the inlet means comprises an inlet slope disposed about the first circumference of the cooling means and the outlet means comprises an outlet slope disposed about the second circumference of the cooling means.
7. The nozzle of any preceding claim, wherein the inlet means comprises an axial alignment flange configured to axially align the nozzle with another component of the plasma arc torch.
8. The nozzle of any preceding claim, further comprising a third sealing member located between the second sealing member and the proximal end of the body.

9. The nozzle of claim 8, further comprising a vent hole located between the third sealing member and the second sealing member, the vent hole configured to connect an interior surface of the body to the exterior surface of the body.

10. The nozzle of claim 8, further comprising a supply hole located between the third sealing member and the proximal end of the body, the supply hole configured to connect an exterior surface of the body to the interior surface of the body.

11. The nozzle of any preceding claim, further comprising a vent hole between the first sealing member and the distal end of the body, the vent hole configured to connect an interior surface of the body to a shield gas supply channel.
12. The nozzle of any preceding claim, further comprising a retaining cap coupled to the exterior surface of the body to define a chamber in cooperation with the cooling means.
13. The nozzle of claim 12, wherein the chamber has a volume of about 0.03 cubic inches.

14. The nozzle of any preceding claim, wherein the cooling means is further defined by a heat exchange region between the inlet and outlet means, the heat exchange region extending substantially parallel to the longitudinal axis.
15. The nozzle of any preceding claim, wherein the inlet means and the outlet means are oriented generally perpendicular to the longitudinal axis.
